title: Sunday · a third of a page, measured
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Before A Third of a Page begins: the last full-size Sunday, and it draws its own edges — the tiers with a ruler laid along them, the reader invited to measure now so they can measure later. The landscape is the flats; the subject is the size.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the flats at low tide with a steel ruler drawn lying along the tier's bottom edge, its marks visible.

image.prompt: tidal mudflats at low tide with a steel ruler drawn lying along the bottom edge of the image with its marks visible, a small three-legged dog far out, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Ruler

panels.composition: Tier 2: the flats closer, the ruler along this tier's edge too.

image.prompt: tidal mudflats closer with a steel ruler drawn along the image's bottom edge, a small three-legged dog nearer, watercolor

panels.name: Middle

panels.composition: Tier 3: the tide line, the ruler's end, the paper's edge; the pup's paw on the ruler.

image.prompt: a tide line with a drawn steel ruler ending at the paper's edge and a small three-legged dog's paw resting on the ruler, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Edge

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Measure now. A Third of a Page begins in May.
